notes.title: NEW NAOMI DLC: FREE RELEASE
notes.notes:
HELLO GUYS! I HAVE MADE A NEW DLC FOR THE GAME!

[b]NOTICE![/b]
THIS  FREE DLC WILL ONLY BE AVAILABLE FOR 24 HOURS!

In this special DLC you have the option to date your friend Naomi. For now I have implemented it as its own separate route but in future updates you can select this special route through selected a third unlock-able option in Ishida's route! However, in this version it is already unlocked! Play it here!

https://jagaimo-studios.itch.io/otome-legends-naomi-dlc
